facts.fact: 四人连夜开车次日下午到 safe house；Douglas 被胶带封嘴
facts.anchor: Eventually David takes some duct tape from the glove compartment and orders Jules to tape their hostage’s mouth shut.

facts.fact: Bethany 睡大部分路程、梦话「The cobwebs…No. Stop it. That's not my name.」
facts.anchor: “The cobwebs,” she mumbles. Jules catches stray bits of sleep talk. “No. Stop it. That’s not my name.”

facts.fact: 过德州-新墨西哥边界半小时后 Bethany 醒；认出 David、Jules、Douglas
facts.anchor: Bethany finally wakes up about a half hour after they cross the Texas–New Mexico border.

facts.fact: Bethany 自称感觉「像劫持了一家科技公司然后被爆头」
facts.anchor: “Like I held a tech company hostage and then got shot in the head.”

facts.fact: David 说太远回不了营地、今晚借住朋友处；Bethany 问「Am I your prisoner?」他不答
facts.anchor: “Am I your prisoner?” she asks David in the rearview mirror.

facts.fact: 粉色牧场 tech-free zone（无 Wi-Fi/手机/电器）；Patricia 接待并说 Bethany 要谈的是她奶奶
facts.anchor: “Welcome to the ranch,” he says. “This is a tech-free zone. No Wi-Fi, no cell service, no electronics of any kind for miles. You’ll be able to detox here.”

facts.fact: Patricia 与 David 给 Bethany 包扎、镊取玻璃、给药；坐轮椅的老人 Rachel 出场
facts.anchor: This is my grandmother,” Patricia says as she parks the wheelchair in the doorway so that the old woman is facing Bethany. “Her name is Rachel.”

facts.fact: Rachel 打量 Bethany「So this is her…Our receiver, perhaps? After waiting so long?」
facts.anchor: “So this is her, yes? The girl you’ve been excited about? Our receiver, perhaps? After waiting so long?”
